searchText: when you say "second slashing for blocks" do you mean we ignore the 2nd block on gossip that could produce a proposer slashing? I do think it's fine to keep the IGNORE itself, we should not forward such a block, but clients can produce a slashing from it, this could even be expressed in the executable specs and call `on_proposer_slashing`, that should probably be a separate PR though Clients should not send the slashing, assuming they already sent the first one, the second one is clutter (and by the way <@592004585506340885> it may be good to check we have tests with blocks that include two different valid slashings for the same validator) ah yeah so you worried the timestamp is overriden? I'm sorry I didn't understand this question I am mostly don't understand what's the concern of broadcasting multiple different slashings? They are useless They are worse than useless as they will propagate probably and occupy bandwidth for no reason yeah agree, lodestar currently doesn't publish a new proposer slashing if we already seen one, but that's due to the gossip ignore rule, maybe I misunderstand what you meant that we should remove it this is the ignore we are talking about right? ``` [IGNORE] The proposer slashing is the first valid proposer slashing received for the proposer with index proposer_slashing.signed_header_1.message.proposer_index. ``` Yes so there's that one and the first ignore in the beacon block gossip that I think should be removed or at least made optional

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: when you say "second slashing for blocks" do you mean we ignore the 2nd block on gossip that could produce a proposer slashing? I do think it's fine to keep the IGNORE itself, we should not forward such a block, but clients can produce a slashing from it, this could even be expressed in the executable specs and call `on_proposer_slashing`, that should probably be a separate PR though

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Clients should not send the slashing, assuming they already sent the first one, the second one is clutter (and by the way <@592004585506340885> it may be good to check we have tests with blocks that include two different valid slashings for the same validator)

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
yeah agree, lodestar currently doesn't publish a new proposer slashing if we already seen one, but that's due to the gossip ignore rule, maybe I misunderstand what you meant that we should remove it

this is the ignore we are talking about right?
```
[IGNORE] The proposer slashing is the first valid proposer slashing received for the proposer with index proposer_slashing.signed_header_1.message.proposer_index.
```

excerpts.content: Yes so there's that one and the first ignore in the beacon block gossip that I think should be removed or at least made optional
